issue_context.title: Add Tracing to the kubelet's read-only endpoint
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Follow-up to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105126.  Discussed in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105126#discussion_r783142176.

As part of kubelet tracing beta, we should add tracing support to the kubelet's read-only endpoint, which currently does not have tracing.  It should use WithPublicEndpoint to prevent callers from influencing sampling decisions.

### Why is this needed?

Part of https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/2831

Could I help with this issue?  @dashpole

Sure.  See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/server/server.go#L195.  We pass a NoOp  Tracer provider to disable tracing for the endpoint.  Instead, we need to pass the tracerprovider, but make sure that the eventual [otelrestful filter](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/server/server.go#L333) uses withPublicEndpoint.

Looking closer, i'm not sure its currently possible to use WithPublicEndpoint with the otelrestful package... https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib/blob/main/instrumentation/github.com/emicklei/go-restful/otelrestful/config.go doesn't contain that option (unlike otelhttp: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib/blob/main/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp/config.go#L110), so we may need to add that upstream first.

Another thing to keep in mind is that updating otel libraries is currently blocked by https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/113366 (see my attempt 
in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/115208)

I gave the whole thing another try.  At least locally, the dependencies seem now to be able to be updated. :raccoon: 

Could you maybe have a look at it @dashpole? :)
